bustSpanEase.name: Bust span ease (%)
bustSpanEase.help: Controls the amount of ease along the bust span

chestEase.name: Chest ease (%)
chestEase.help: Controls the amount of ease at the chest

fullChestEaseReduction.name: Full chest ease reduction (%)
fullChestEaseReduction.help: Allows you to independently reduce the ease around the chest to make it fit tight(er) in that area

shoulderToShoulderEase.name: Shoulder to shoulder ease (%)
shoulderToShoulderEase.help: Controls the amount of ease along the shoulder to shoulder measurement

waistEase.name: Waist ease (%)
waistEase.help: Controls the amount of ease at the waist

backHemSlope.name: Back hem slope (°)
backHemSlope.help: Controls the slope of the back hem

backNeckCutout.name: Back neck cutout (%)
backNeckCutout.help: Controls how deep the neck is cutout in the back

frontShoulderWidth.name: Front shoulder width (%)
frontShoulderWidth.help: Controls how much width is added to the shoulder in the front

highBustWidth.name: High bust width (%)
highBustWidth.help: Controls the width of the high bust

armholeDartCurvePoint.name: Armhole princess seam curve point (%)
armholeDartCurvePoint.help: This controls where (vertically) the curve of the princess seam starts

armholeDartCurveWidth.name: Armhole princess seam curve width (%)
armholeDartCurveWidth.help: This controls the radius of the curve of the princess seam

armholeDartCurved.name: Princess Seam Curviness
armholeDartCurved.help: Controls the curvature of the princess seam

armholeDartPosition.name: Armhole dart position (%)
armholeDartPosition.help: Controls the position of the armhole dart

armholeDepth.name: Armhole depth (%)
armholeDepth.help: Controls the depth of the armhole

backArmholeCurvature.name: Back armhole curvature (%)
backArmholeCurvature.help: Controls how deep the armhole is scooped out at the back

backArmholePitchDepth.name: Back armhole pitch depth (%)
backArmholePitchDepth.help: Controls how deep the armhole cuts into the back

backArmholeSlant.name: Back armhole slant (°)
backArmholeSlant.help: Controls the slant of the armhole at the back

frontArmholeCurvature.name: Front armhole curvature (%)
frontArmholeCurvature.help: Controls how deep the armhole is scooped out at the front bottom

frontArmholePitchDepth.name: Front armhole pitch depth (%)
frontArmholePitchDepth.help: Controls how deep the armhole cuts into the front

backDartHeight.name: Controls the height of the back dart (%)

waistDartLength.name: Waist dart length (%)
waistDartLength.help: Controls the length of the waist dart

dartPosition.name: Dart position
dartPosition.help: Controls whether to split at the shoulder or armhole

shoulderDartCurvature.name: Shoulder dart curvature (%)
shoulderDartCurvature.help: Controls the curvature of the upper part of the shoulder dart

shoulderDartPosition.name: Shoulder dart position (%)
shoulderDartPosition.help: Controls the position of the shoulder dart

upperDartLength.name: Upper dart length (%)
upperDartLength.help: Controls the length of the upper dart

waistdartposition.name: Waist dart position (%)
waistdartposition.help: Controls the position of the waist 'dart', moving it to the center (negative) or side (positive)
